mods.name: secret-filename-guard
mods.description: Asks before a Bash command touches a secret-looking file (.env, private keys, credentials).

mods.name: secret-guard
mods.description: Asks before a live API key, token or private key is written, edited or run.

mods.name: env-exfil-guard
mods.description: Asks before a command prints your environment, echoes a secret variable or sends local data to a remote host.

mods.name: infra-guard
mods.description: Asks before terraform destroy, kubectl delete, force-push, DROP TABLE or rm -rf.

mods.name: secret-commit-guard
mods.description: Asks before a git commit that would record a credential or a secret-named file. Reads the staged diff with git.

mods.name: protect-main
mods.description: Asks before a commit, push or merge while you are on main or master. Reads the branch with git.

mods.name: gitignore-check
mods.description: Asks before git add or commit when secret-looking files are not ignored or are already tracked. Checks with git ls-files.

mods.name: secret-output-guard
mods.description: Tells Claude not to repeat a credential that showed up in command or file output, and names the source to rotate.

mods.name: curl-pipe-guard
mods.description: Asks before a download is piped into a shell or interpreter (curl | sh, wget -O- | bash, bash <(curl ...)).

mods.name: sudo-guard
mods.description: Asks before sudo, doas or su -c runs a command with elevated rights.

mods.name: no-verify-guard
mods.description: Asks before git hooks are skipped (--no-verify, commit -n, HUSKY=0, core.hooksPath=/dev/null).

mods.name: lockfile-guard
mods.description: Asks before a lockfile is written or edited by hand; the package manager should change it.

mods.name: package-guard
mods.description: Asks before a new dependency is installed (npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, pip, uv, poetry, cargo, go, gem) and names the packages.

mods.name: prod-db-guard
mods.description: Asks before destructive SQL runs in a command: TRUNCATE, DELETE or UPDATE with no WHERE.

mods.name: path-jail
mods.description: Asks before Write, Edit or NotebookEdit changes a file outside the working directory, by real path.

mods.name: guard-essentials
mods.description: Asks only before harsh or disaster commands: destructive infra, git and SQL, piping downloads into a shell, sudo, leaking or committing secrets. Reads git. The quiet choice for daily work.

mods.name: guard-pack
mods.description: Every Baselane guard in one mod. Some read git, measure files with find, read HOME with printenv, or check where a path really lands.
